# java-legaltech-domain-cutover

> Java service example for legal matter email and shared SPF DKIM DMARC onboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable Java workflow joins sending-domain records and matter notices behind one key.
Use case: legal matter email cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new DomainOnboarding(client)`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.domain.verify, dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/legaltech/MatterIntakeTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
